title: ReviewReport artifact
description: Produced by the Reviewer in REVIEW. ADVISORY. The verdict enumeration deliberately has no 'success' member: a Task becomes successful only through a zero verification exit code (ADR-0014). The Reviewer exists to catch what an exit code cannot — a change that passes its test while doing something undesirable — and its findings go to the human reviewer, where a judgement call belongs.

verdict.description: 'approve' means the Reviewer has no blocking objection; it does not mean the Task succeeded. Routing still requires a passing verification.
